subject: Evidence request: incident response controls, SIG/CAIQ mapping, and transfer plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardbank.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.inference
Cc: procurements@orchardbank.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: incident response controls & mapping

Hi Neha,

Thanks for putting us in touch. As part of Orchard Bank's upcoming vendor security review we're collecting a short package that covers incident response and related evidence. Specifically, could you provide: 

- An excerpt of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) that covers detection, escalation, and customer notification processes (redacted is fine).
- A control mapping matrix tying SOC 2 CC* controls to SIG v2 items and CAIQ questions where applicable.
- A sample of the types of telemetry/logs you can provide (authentication logs, audit trails) and the retention policy for those logs.

We need the package by Apr 9 to make our internal committee deadline on Apr 12. Prefer secure transfer (Box link or SFTP). If there are any items that must be requested via legal/procurement, flag them.

We can jump on a 30-min sync if that's easier — happy to be flexible this week.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Information Security Manager
Orchard Bank
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.inference
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference, diego_fernandez@redwood.inference, soojin_lee@redwood.inference, procurements@orchardbank.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: incident response controls & mapping

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of what we can deliver by your Apr 9 deadline: 

- Redacted IRP excerpt (customer-facing sections only) — will include detection, escalation, notification timing and example runbooks.
- Control mapping matrix (SOC 2 -> SIG v2 -> CAIQ) as an editable spreadsheet.
- Sample telemetry: authentication events, token issuance logs, and an aggregated example of audit events (redacted); plus a description of our retention windows and where logs reside.

I'm attaching an initial draft control-matrix and an IRP excerpt for your review (see attachments). We'll run the full evidence package through Soojin for redaction and Irene for any legal/sensitivity flags before final delivery.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: acknowledge and share initial artifacts (attached).
- Tomorrow EOD Apr 6: final redacted IRP excerpt + control matrix v1.
- Apr 8: technical artifacts & logs packaged and uploaded via secure link (or sooner if you prefer).

If Apr 9 is a hard deadline for your committee, we'll prioritize the packaging. Please confirm secure transfer preference (Box link or SFTP) and if Procurements needs any PO/DocuSign references.

Attachments: redwood_irp_excerpt.pdf (pdf), control-matrix-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.inference
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.inference
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.inference, Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardbank.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.inference, irene_choi@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: incident response controls & mapping

Samir / Neha — tagging in some technical clarifications so we hand you the right artifacts: 

1) Logs: we can export auth/audit logs covering a specific date range (parquet or csv). For security reasons we will redact PII and customer identifiers; we can provide mapping documentation to explain fields.
2) Retention: primary auth logs are retained 90 days hot, 365 days cold; audit traces retained 730 days (indexed).
3) Timeline: export + sanitization takes ~36 hours for a 30-day window.

I'll attach a tiny sample extract so you can confirm format — full export will be delivered via the secure link. Also note: any requests for raw kernel/network captures or full memory images require an IR/legal approval — I mention just in case.

Attachment: auth-logs-sample.csv (csv)

If Box is preferred we'll prepare a password-protected folder and share the link; if SFTP, we'll coordinate creds with Procurements/your team.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Security Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orchardbank.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.inference
Cc: procurements@orchardbank.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: incident response controls & mapping

Thanks Neha and Diego — that timeline looks good. Box is preferred for Orchard's security team (we already have an enterprise Box account configured for inbound vendor uploads). Please: 

- Deliver the redacted IRP excerpt + control matrix by EOD Apr 6.
- Provide the sanitized log export via a password-protected Box folder by Apr 8.
- For legal/procurements: DocuSign reference is 0Z9X-K2P4. Procurements copied here will follow up for any PO/terms but we don't expect a delay.

One ask on the control matrix: if you can add a column that indicates "evidence artifact name" (e.g., IRP section, log export filename, runbook id) that will make sign-off faster.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will aim for a Thursday committee prep review on Apr 9.

Samir
